items.headline: Credit investors stay wary of AI names even as equities shake off the AI rout; CoreWeave CDS ~1,082bp, Oracle ~315bp
items.note: CoreWeave 5y CDS above 1,000bp is read as distress-level pricing and Oracle's has widened sharply year over year, even though no default or downgrade has occurred.

items.headline: Oracle CDS hits record 288bp on AI debt concerns (BBB- rated, S&P downgraded in July)
items.note: Oracle sits one notch above junk with $118B of long-term debt, so further widening could threaten its investment-grade funding access.

items.headline: Tech default insurance hits record highs: CoreWeave CDS tops 1,100bp, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia also at record CDS levels
items.note: Record CDS across hyperscalers shows the stress is spreading beyond neoclouds, though their spreads remain far below Oracle's and CoreWeave's.

items.headline: CoreWeave's ~$51B debt and lease pile sparks AI-bubble fears; swaps imply >60% five-year default odds
items.note: Market-implied default odds are an analyst-style read of CDS pricing rather than a realized event, but they show how costly refinancing could become.
